Ms. Lee needs money exchange service. She wants to cash traveler's checks and change currencies at the Grand Hotel. 15-7

Excuse me. I'd like to cash some traveler's checks.

Fine. May I see your passport, ma'am? Thank you. Please sign your name on the back of each check.

A few seconds later..

Excuse me. I'd like to change some bills. What is today's exchange rate?

It's one US dollar to thirty NT dollars.

OK, I'd like to change fifty USD into TWD.

Sure. Here you are. Be sure to keep this receipt. You will need it when you want to change your NT dollars back to US dollars.

You are welcome. It's my pleasure. Have a nice day!

Ms. Lee is checking out from the Grand Hotel.

日本溫泉飯店的「送別」是最有趣的景象。當顧客離開飯店之時，服務人員都會在門口逐一對他們鞠躬致謝；當顧客的車輛發動之後，服務人員對著逐漸遠去的客人不停地揮手送行，直到客人的車輛消失在道路盡頭之後，會再次深深地鞠躬致意。
